additional_info.subject: RE: ID0480116-DC/Si-D/IT- [Y2/SD314015297001] Log Check CRM:00263000481
additional_info.body:
Dear Rosita,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0480116.
I analyzed the sessions on 23.02.2026, and they failed for two different reasons. Here is my analysis:
The customer which was not able to charge has EV with EVMAC "fc.a4.7a.14.b6.ee"
The first session failed at 2026-02-23T15:43:23, because the customer authenticated for outlet 1 and connected outlet 2
Second session is at 2026-02-23T16:28:31, and again authenticated via app for DC1 and connected DC2
Third session is at 2026-02-23T16:30:32, and again authenticated via app for DC1 and connected DC2
Fourth session is at 2026-02-23T16:35:29. Customer authenticated for DC1, removed the plug and plug it in back in DC2, but at 2026-02-23T16:38:15 he authenticated for DC2, and the session started the start-up process.
Here we can see the second reason why the sessions failed. At 2026-02-23T16:38:35, the charger enters P04_PRE_CHARGE phase.
In one second, the charger raises the voltage (EVSE_NowVol) to match the voltage of the EV batteries (EV_TarVol), but then we wait for 1 minute to receive the Power delivery request from the EV. The power delivery request does not arrive, and after 1 minute we stop the session.
Fifth session is at 2026-02-23T16:43:42. Customer authenticated for DC1, plugged in DC2, and after 2 minutes authenticated for DC2.
The session proceeded forward, and failed again at 2026-02-23T16:46:58 during P04_PRE_CHARGE, because the EV is not sending the power delivery request.
At 2026-02-23T16:50:32 a reboot was performed
After charger came back online, at 2026-02-23T16:57:58 customer authenticated for DC2 and plugged in DC2.
Session failed again at 2026-02-23T16:59:38 because EV did not send Power Delivery request.
Last attempt at 2026-02-23T17:09:39, again he tried for the seventh time and failed for the same reason.
In conclusion, the first sessions failed because the user connected the wrong outlet after authentication.
The other sessions failed during PreCharge, because the Charger was ready to start the power delivery, but the EV never sent the Power delivery request. The charger kept the communication open, but after 1 minute closed the session.
Therefore, there is no issue with the charger, but the issue was in the wrong handling of the charging session and in the EV.
Please let me know if further support is required, otherwise I will proceed to close the ticket.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
